title: SOCIAL CHEMISTRY 101: Learning to Reason about Social and Moral Norms

bias_targets.methodology: Generating Rules-of-Thumb (RoTs) and moral attributes for news headlines using a trained Neural Norm Transformer model, and correlating the generated moral foundations (e.g., fairness/care vs. sanctity/loyalty) with the known political leanings (left-leaning vs. right-leaning) of the news sources.

Using a generalized linear model to regress categorical social and moral annotations (such as social judgment, action agreement, and cultural pressure) against worker demographic variables including gender, urbanness, education, income, age, and political affiliation to identify variations in moral judgments.
